name: ai_assisted_eval_loop
description: G0 protocol freeze + field-wise promote/stop bars for the AI-assisted draft→adjudicate→CM→fix loop. Machine-readable companion to AI_ASSISTED_EVAL_LOOP.md.

live_runs.note: Tooling may be built anytime. Do not start label_sheet_anti_geo / blind-judge API batches / full-sheet CM campaigns while another agent owns in-flight data/permissions_eval artifacts.

parasitic.notes: State empty/rare gold suspected; prefer kappa / per-class

factual_permission.notes: Primary gap; systematic-error cut also counts

mention_permission.notes: Near-constant allow; not a promotion driver

knob_freeze.rule: If field macro_f1 >= bar on prefer_sheet (else fallback), do not change knobs aimed at that field unless documenting a held-out regression repair.

paper.claim_ready: AI-assisted gold labeling: an LLM proposes draft permissions/parasitic labels from LABEL_GUIDE only; a human adjudicates (accept/edit/reject) to produce evaluation gold; Anti-GEO is re-run as the system under test; primary CMs compare system predictions to adjudication; Human–LLM agreement is a label-noise ceiling; Group A and Group B remain independent.
